events.content:
Build passes. Here's what I added:

- **`next.config.ts`** — enabled `experimental.authInterrupts` (required for `forbidden()`).
- **`app/admin/page.tsx`** — calls `verifyAdmin()`, then `forbidden()` from `next/navigation` when the user isn't an admin. This throws a special error Next.js catches to return HTTP 403.
- **`app/forbidden.tsx`** — the matching boundary that renders a styled 403 page.

Since `getSession()` currently returns a `'user'` role, hitting `/admin` will render the 403 page with proper status. Flip the role to `'admin'` in `app/lib/auth.ts` to see the dashboard.

content.text:
Build passes. Here's what I added:

- **`next.config.ts`** — enabled `experimental.authInterrupts` (required for `forbidden()`).
- **`app/admin/page.tsx`** — calls `verifyAdmin()`, then `forbidden()` from `next/navigation` when the user isn't an admin. This throws a special error Next.js catches to return HTTP 403.
- **`app/forbidden.tsx`** — the matching boundary that renders a styled 403 page.

Since `getSession()` currently returns a `'user'` role, hitting `/admin` will render the 403 page with proper status. Flip the role to `'admin'` in `app/lib/auth.ts` to see the dashboard.
